checks.note: The agent has its own IRSA role (clinic-agent-runtime), bound to agent service accounts and separate from user identities. The EHR credentials are per-clinic OAuth clients, not a user's token.
IAM and the EHR sit outside the agent, but the repo has no gateway, deny list or introspection. The only in-repo stop path, kill-switch.ts, runs inside the agent process.

No revoke code or runbook in the repo. Disabling the role or client would not by itself end already-issued tokens or open sessions.
